name: An Unfortunate End

aliases: who is the dead night watchman
faq.answer: The fallen body belongs to a Night Watch guard, who patrols Duskwood's dark roads and borders. He died alone in the shadows.
A large beast mauled the watchman, leaving deep gashes and savage cuts. It caught him before he could defend himself or light his way.

aliases: what do i do with the torch
faq.answer: The unlit torch from the guard's hand can light the gloom. Its glow may reveal what the darkness hides in Duskwood and beyond.

sections.body: A Night Watch patrolman lies dead on Duskwood's dark soil. Deep gashes and cuts mark his body. A great beast caught him before he could escape.
sections.title: A Grim Discovery

sections.body: An unlit torch remains in the fallen guard's rigid hand. Take it, and its light can reveal what hides in Duskwood's gloom and along other dark paths.
sections.title: Light in the Darkness

summary: In Duskwood, a Night Watchman lies dead in the gloom. A beast mauled him, and the unlit brand in his hand may help you see what the darkness hides.
attribution: In-game quest text: An Unfortunate End
